o: Bhutan has a constitutional provision to maintain 60% of its geographical area under forest.
Tropical rainforest soil is nutrient-poor, and regeneration is slow once the forest is cleared.
Dense forests are mostly found away from the equator.
Canada is the largest producer and exporter of softwood timber and wood pulp.
